notes:
Guide places channels with current/upcoming programmes first, then channels without guide coverage. Fullscreen browsing adds All, Favorites, Recent and categories with shared search.
Numeric tuning Off now hides channel-number labels and entry overlays. The floating fullscreen button no longer appears after the player bar hides; fullscreen remains in the bar.
This version enables direct downloads for future updates, with percentage/byte progress, Hide, Cancel, Retry and verified installation. Older builds open their browser once to install this release. Android controls installation and may require allowing updates from StreamAtlas.
HW/HW+ now explain VLC decoding-only versus decoding plus direct rendering, with explicit HW aligned to official VLC options. Auto, SW, normal Media3 selection, native libraries, stream buffers and EPG providers remain unchanged.
